bargaining.population: all games first observed at round 1 with empty history, assigned by the frozen bargaining rule, and enrolled before the exclusive assignment cutoff
bargaining.outcome_deadline_policy: first_observed_ts plus maturity_lag_seconds; missing, late, conflicting, or invalid terminals are zero and block integrity when malformed

negotiation.population: strictly enrolled negotiation games at their first exact action-level divergence in the frozen buyer round-9 hidden-value max-rounds-10 reference cells
negotiation.outcome_deadline_policy: first_observed_ts plus maturity_lag_seconds; pending games are excluded until mature and later terminals never repair a fixed deadline outcome

persuasion.population: all games first observed at round 1 with empty history, assigned by the frozen persuasion rule, with seller role and is_seller_know_cv exactly false
persuasion.outcome_deadline_policy: first_observed_ts plus maturity_lag_seconds; missing, late, conflicting, or invalid terminals are zero and block integrity when malformed

prefix_manifest.path_order: ascending UTF-8 byte order of project-relative POSIX paths

event_log_paths.prefix_rule: from byte zero through the newline ending the last contiguous record whose literal numeric top-level ts is at most analysis_as_of; timestamps must be nondecreasing and every included record must be strict UTF-8 JSON

assignment_receipt_paths.prefix_rule: the complete newline-terminated physical file snapshot; every record must pin the declared artifact and plan and have enrolled_at in the half-open assignment window

physical_read.open_mode: component-wise dirfd walk with O_NOFOLLOW, then O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW
physical_read.snapshot: capture device, inode, and size from the opened descriptor; read no more than the declared per-file bound; reject a changed descriptor identity or a non-newline-terminated selected prefix

prefix_manifest.aggregate_identity: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for the exact ordered entry array, using sorted object keys and separators comma and colon, prefixed by confirmation-prefix-manifest-v1 plus a NUL byte
